userStories.title: Pipeline ordering matches Section 9.4
acceptanceCriteria: run_weekly executes steps in the order: scan, cluster, pass 1 batched, pass 2 frontier on low-confidence, moments validation, selector, follow-up, render
Each step's outputs feed only the documented downstream steps
userStories.notes: run_weekly() added to praxis/orchestrator.py with 8 mockable step functions (_step_scan, _step_cluster, _step_pass1, _step_pass2, _step_validate_moments, _step_select_moments, _step_follow_up, _step_render). Pass1Output wraps results+low_confidence_session_ids so pass2 receives only IDs, never pass1 scores (spec 9.1). New tests in test_orchestrator.py monkeypatch each step and assert the call sequence equals the Section 9.4 order, and that each step receives only documented upstream outputs.

userStories.title: Persist weekly_digests row with snapshot_json
acceptanceCriteria: A weekly_digests row is written for the current week_iso with generated_at, trajectory_label, trajectory_headline, headline_moment_id, cost_total_usd, cost_baseline_usd, snapshot_json, and html_path
snapshot_json contains the full ProfileSnapshot for the week
Re-running on the same week is idempotent (UPSERT semantics)
userStories.notes: Added ProfileStore.save_weekly_digest / load_weekly_digest / count_weekly_digests with INSERT OR REPLACE on the week_iso PK. snapshot_json is asdict(ProfileSnapshot). run_weekly() now computes trajectory via extract_signals + assess_trajectory (off scanned sessions, not via a new pipeline step) and UPSERTs the digest row after render. WeeklyRunSummary gains trajectory/cost_total_usd/cost_baseline_usd/digest_persisted fields. cost_total_usd and cost_baseline_usd are wired through as None pending US-073. html_path is None until the render step starts writing files.

userStories.title: --dry-run computes without persisting
acceptanceCriteria: A --dry-run flag wires through the orchestrator and prevents DB writes and file writes
userStories.notes: Added `dry_run: bool = False` parameter to run_weekly(). When True: skips ProfileStore construction (no profile.db write), skips save_weekly_digest call (no DB row), and passes dry_run=True kwarg through to _step_render so future file-write logic can short-circuit while still computing rendered strings. Explicit store= injection does NOT override dry_run - defense-in-depth so the flag cannot be defeated. The full pipeline still executes; only side effects are suppressed. WeeklyRunSummary.rendered_terminal is populated as usual so terminal output remains available.

userStories.title: Performance target on 30-session week
acceptanceCriteria: A 30-session synthetic fixture completes run_weekly in under 120 seconds wall time on the developer machine
Total LLM spend on that fixture is under $2
A perf test records the measurement
userStories.notes: Added praxis/scoring/cost.py with estimate_weekly_pipeline_cost() that sums per-call costs across cluster + pass1 + pass2 + selector using model-card pricing (chars/4 -> tokens, then per-million rate). run_weekly() now populates cost_total_usd from the estimate (clamped to None when 0.0) and reads cost_baseline_usd via new ProfileStore.weekly_cost_baseline(before_week_iso, lookback_days=90), which AVG()s prior weekly_digests.cost_total_usd over the last 90 days excluding the current week. Baseline read is inside the `if not dry_run` block (dry-run never touches the store). New perf test writes 30 synthetic Claude JSONL files into tmp_home with mtimes spread across the past week, stubs score_session/cluster_sessions/select_moments_with_fallback (no real LLM keys available in tests), runs run_weekly(), and asserts wall<120s + cost_total<$2 + prints the measurement. Real-stub measurement: ~8ms wall, ~$0.33 projected spend. Headroom is huge by design - the gate exists to catch regressions where the pipeline grows an O(N^2) loop or a synchronous network call we forgot to mock.
